name: Rechargeable 3-Head Electric Shaver Set (Full Kit)
description: A rechargeable rotary shaver with three floating heads and a battery display on the body. In the box: shaver, hair clipper head with 3, 5 and 7 mm guides, nose trimmer, sideburn trimmer, face brush head, spare shaver head, head cover, USB charging cable, cleaning brush and instructions. Charges over USB.

source.notes: Listing has 20 styles (kits) priced from ¥61.8 (₦13,758.73) to ¥101 (₦22,485.94); price per kit not known, so unit_cost left empty until the owner picks the kit(s). Screenshot is Style 17/20 (shaver + nose trimmer + clipper with 3/5/7 mm guides). Rechargeable lithium battery (USB), capacity not stated. Store return rate not visible; repurchase rate 20.59%, 4K+ sold. Not used as our claims: 365-day replace-not-repair banner, '1 hour charge = 3 months use', whole-body washable. Packed weight 410 g (owner), estimated. Kit photos all carry Chinese labels and the promo banner, so only the shaver and head close-up were used. Full kit = every head (F kit photo). Unit cost is ASSUMED (cheapest/dearest of the listing range) until the owner sends style prices. Weight 0.41 kg is the owner figure for the listing; the full kit may weigh more. Price raised from NGN 45000 to NGN 57000 on 9 Nov 2026 (owner approved margin review: 60% floor).
